announcements.title: What's New in v2.0.0
bullets: TidyWL Pro is here: clean-up rules, Pin, a preview before bulk deletes, undo with a Delete history, saved views, sidebar search and the Lineup. Nothing that was free has moved behind it: https://tidywl.com/pro/
Group by channel: three new sorts put a heading before each channel (most videos, fewest videos, or A to Z), and you can fold a channel shut
Delete from a merged view: with several playlists ticked, Delete removes a video from all of them at once
A tidier toolbar, grouped into Find, Pro tools, Select & move and Export & open, plus a help button that opens the tutorials
Fixed: clicking a channel in the sidebar could also show videos from channels with a similar name
The usage report now also counts Lineups and the days you open the dashboard, once a day at most, so we can see how many people use it each week. Still never which videos: https://tidywl.com/privacy/
New name, same extension: Watch Later Tidy
